_comment: 884/rung1-selfplay-base TRAIN window. Identical to experiments/821_planner_daily/period_821_train.json EXCEPT end_date 2025-12-01 -> 2025-10-04, so the held-out window is 2025-10-05..2026-03-31 — byte-identical to the OOS window the imprint lane was graded on (LEDGER 861/ref-oos-rebase, 875/wf-generalization), which makes self-play vs hard-target BC an apples-to-apples generalization comparison instead of an approximate one. The 64-symbol asset list is copied BYTE-FOR-BYTE and asserted ORDER-EXACT against runs/832_e5/frame_provenance_imprint.json at write time, so rung-1 checkpoints are gradable with that existing provenance file and no hand-derivation (the TASK_874 gap) is needed. Deviation pre-registered in the rung-1 SPEC §3.
